shared_elements: human head wearing a tall headdress/crown
vertical grooved or striped band across the headgear
justification: Both show a stone-carved human head crowned by a tall headdress marked with vertical grooves, with patterned relief motifs (circles/spirals) filling the surface below it, and both stack head-over-body from top to bottom. But A is a heavily eroded, near-freestanding frontal monolith with broad, shallow, schematic devices, while B is a crisp, shallow profile relief with obsessively regular, miniature curl-work — utterly different scale of detail, viewpoint and finish.
